structure.note: closed lists, read from engine/program/names.py and engine/sheet/names.py

names.name: form:show
names.definition: reads a labelled cell, or lists the values on the kept lines

names.name: form:agg
names.definition: one figure over the kept lines

names.name: form:rank
names.definition: the top line, group or peer column

names.name: form:calc
names.definition: the difference, sum or ratio of two one-number programs

names.name: size:signed
names.definition: a figure read with its sign

names.name: size:by_size
names.definition: a group or peer ranks by the size of its total

names.name: size:each
names.definition: a measure read line by line with its sign dropped

names.name: size:stated
names.definition: the signed result stated by its size

names.name: entity:line
names.definition: the line holding the top value

names.name: entity:group
names.definition: the key whose lines add up highest

names.name: entity:peer
names.definition: the peer column holding the top value

names.name: row_op:+
names.definition: two measures of one line added

names.name: row_op:-
names.definition: one measure of a line less another

names.name: row_op:*
names.definition: two measures of one line multiplied

names.name: row_op:/
names.definition: one measure of a line over another

names.name: word_role:measure
names.definition: the word names what is measured

names.name: word_role:key
names.definition: the word names what is grouped by or shown

names.name: word_role:context
names.definition: the word names the sheet, the tab or its subject

names.name: condition:period
names.definition: a date falls in this period

names.name: condition:comparison
names.definition: a number compares with a number stated

names.name: condition:blank
names.definition: a cell is blank or filled

names.name: condition:section
names.definition: a band above the line says this

names.name: condition:line
names.definition: a line's own label holds this

names.name: condition:not_equals
names.definition: a text cell is some other value

names.name: anchor:anywhere
names.definition: the text sits anywhere in the cell

names.name: measure_kind:row_arithmetic
names.definition: two columns of one line under an operator

names.name: measure_kind:size
names.definition: a measure with its sign dropped

names.name: measure_kind:date
names.definition: a date column read as its day

names.name: measure_kind:across
names.definition: peer columns of one line added

names.name: column_role:key
names.definition: text naming the record, mostly distinct

names.name: column_role:section_label
names.definition: a sparse label filled down over the lines under it

names.name: column_role:peer
names.definition: one of several columns of one axis

names.name: column_role:tab_name
names.definition: the tab a family member came from

names.name: line_role:subtotal
names.definition: a printed summary of part of a table

names.name: line_role:total
names.definition: a printed summary of a whole table

names.name: line_role:band
names.definition: a section label over the lines under it

names.name: line_role:note
names.definition: a label and value outside a table

names.name: value_kind:marker
names.definition: a filled cell saying no value: -, n/a

properties.name: schema:geo
properties.text: geo: The geo coordinates of the place.

properties.name: schema:about
properties.text: about: The subject matter of an object.

properties.name: schema:actor
properties.text: actor: An actor (individual or a group), e.g. in TV, radio, movie, video games etc., or in an event. Actors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.

properties.name: schema:address
properties.text: address: Physical address of the item.

properties.name: schema:addressCountry
properties.text: address country: The country. Recommended to be in 2-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1) format, for example "US". For backward compatibility, a 3-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-3) country code such as "SGP" or a full country name such as "Singapore" can also be used.

properties.name: schema:affiliation
properties.text: affiliation: An organization that this person is affiliated with. For example, a school/university, a club, or a team.

properties.name: schema:aggregateRating
properties.text: aggregate rating: The overall rating, based on a collection of reviews or ratings, of the item.

properties.name: schema:asin
properties.text: asin: An Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN) is a 10-character alphanumeric unique identifier assigned by Amazon.com and its partners for product identification within the Amazon organization (summary from [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amazon_Standard_Identification_Number)'s article). Note also that this is a definition for how to include ASINs in Schema.org data, and not a definition of ASINs in general - see documentation from Amazon for authoritative details. ASINs are most commonly encoded as text strings, but the [asin] property supports URL/URI as potential values too.

properties.name: schema:author
properties.text: author: The author of this content or rating. Please note that author is special in that HTML 5 provides a special mechanism for indicating authorship via the rel tag. That is equivalent to this and may be used interchangeably.

properties.name: schema:award
properties.text: award: An award won by or for this item.

properties.name: schema:birthDate
properties.text: birth date: Date of birth.

properties.name: schema:brand
properties.text: brand: The brand(s) associated with a product or service, or the brand(s) maintained by an organization or business person.

properties.name: schema:byArtist
properties.text: by artist: The artist that performed this album or recording.

properties.name: schema:character
properties.text: character: Fictional person connected with a creative work.

properties.name: schema:color
properties.text: color: The color of the product.

properties.name: schema:connectedTo
properties.text: connected to: Other anatomical structures to which this structure is connected.

properties.name: schema:contentLocation
properties.text: content location: The location depicted or described in the content. For example, the location in a photograph or painting.

properties.name: schema:countryOfOrigin
properties.text: country of origin: The country of origin of something, including products as well as creative works such as movie and TV content. In the case of TV and movie, this would be the country of the principle offices of the production company or individual responsible for the movie. For other kinds of CreativeWork it is difficult to provide fully general guidance, and properties such as contentLocation and locationCreated may be more applicable. In the case of products, the country of origin of the product. The exact interpretation of this may vary by context and product type, and cannot be fully enumerated here.

properties.name: schema:dateCreated
properties.text: date created: The date on which the CreativeWork was created or the item was added to a DataFeed.

properties.name: schema:director
properties.text: director: A director of e.g. TV, radio, movie, video gaming etc. content, or of an event. Directors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.

properties.name: schema:dissolutionDate
properties.text: dissolution date: The date that this organization was dissolved.

properties.name: schema:distance
properties.text: distance: The distance travelled, e.g. exercising or travelling.

properties.name: schema:editor
properties.text: editor: Specifies the Person who edited the CreativeWork.

properties.name: schema:email
properties.text: email: Email address.

properties.name: schema:founder
properties.text: founder: A person or organization who founded this organization.

properties.name: schema:foundingLocation
properties.text: founding location: The place where the Organization was founded.

properties.name: schema:gender
properties.text: gender: Gender of something, typically a Person, but possibly also fictional characters, animals, etc. While https://schema.org/Male and https://schema.org/Female may be used, text strings are also acceptable for people who are not a binary gender. The gender property can also be used in an extended sense to cover e.g. the gender of sports teams. As with the gender of individuals, we do not try to enumerate all possibilities. A mixed-gender SportsTeam can be indicated with a text value of "Mixed".

properties.name: schema:genre
properties.text: genre: Genre of the creative work, broadcast channel or group.

properties.name: schema:hasOccupation
properties.text: has occupation: The Person's occupation. For past professions, use Role for expressing dates.

properties.name: schema:hasPart
properties.text: has part: Indicates an item or CreativeWork that is part of this item, or CreativeWork (in some sense).

properties.name: schema:height
properties.text: height: The height of the item.

properties.name: schema:image
properties.text: image: An image of the item. This can be a URL or a fully described ImageObject.

properties.name: schema:inLanguage
properties.text: in language: The language of the content or performance or used in an action. Please use one of the language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47). See also availableLanguage.

properties.name: schema:isBasedOn
properties.text: is based on: A resource from which this work is derived or from which it is a modification or adaptation.

properties.name: schema:isPartOf
properties.text: is part of: Indicates an item or CreativeWork that this item, or CreativeWork (in some sense), is part of.

properties.name: schema:issn
properties.text: issn: The International Standard Serial Number (ISSN) that identifies this serial publication. You can repeat this property to identify different formats of, or the linking ISSN (ISSN-L) for, this serial publication.

properties.name: schema:leiCode
properties.text: lei code: An organization identifier that uniquely identifies a legal entity as defined in ISO 17442.

properties.name: schema:license
properties.text: license: A license document that applies to this content, typically indicated by URL.

properties.name: schema:location
properties.text: location: The location of, for example, where an event is happening, where an organization is located, or where an action takes place.

properties.name: schema:locationCreated
properties.text: location created: The location where the CreativeWork was created, which may not be the same as the location depicted in the CreativeWork.

properties.name: schema:logo
properties.text: logo: An associated logo.

properties.name: schema:lyricist
properties.text: lyricist: The person who wrote the words.

properties.name: schema:mainEntityOfPage
properties.text: main entity of page: Indicates a page (or other CreativeWork) for which this thing is the main entity being described. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#mainEntityBackground) for details.

properties.name: schema:memberOf
properties.text: member of: An Organization (or ProgramMembership) to which this Person or Organization belongs.

properties.name: schema:name
properties.text: name: The name of the item.

properties.name: schema:nationality
properties.text: nationality: Nationality of the person.

properties.name: schema:numberOfEmployees
properties.text: number of employees: The number of employees in an organization, e.g. business.

properties.name: schema:operatingSystem
properties.text: operating system: Operating systems supported (Windows 7, OS X 10.6, Android 1.6).

properties.name: schema:owns
properties.text: owns: Things owned by the organization or person.

properties.name: schema:parentOrganization
properties.text: parent organization: The larger organization that this organization is a subOrganization of, if any.

properties.name: schema:parentTaxon
properties.text: parent taxon: Closest parent taxon of the taxon in question.

properties.name: schema:partOfSeries
properties.text: part of series: The series to which this episode or season belongs.

properties.name: schema:postalCode
properties.text: postal code: The postal code. For example, 94043.

properties.name: schema:previousItem
properties.text: previous item: A link to the ListItem that precedes the current one.

properties.name: schema:producer
properties.text: producer: The person or organization who produced the work (e.g. music album, movie, TV/radio series etc.).

properties.name: schema:productionCompany
properties.text: production company: The production company or studio responsible for the item, e.g. series, video game, episode etc.

properties.name: schema:programmingLanguage
properties.text: programming language: The computer programming language.

properties.name: schema:provider
properties.text: provider: The service provider, service operator, or service performer; the goods producer. Another party (a seller) may offer those services or goods on behalf of the provider. A provider may also serve as the seller.

properties.name: schema:publisher
properties.text: publisher: The publisher of the article in question.

properties.name: schema:servesCuisine
properties.text: serves cuisine: The cuisine of the restaurant.

properties.name: schema:softwareVersion
properties.text: software version: Version of the software instance.

properties.name: schema:startTime
properties.text: start time: The startTime of something. For a reserved event or service (e.g. FoodEstablishmentReservation), the time that it is expected to start. For actions that span a period of time, when the action was performed. E.g. John wrote a book from *January* to December. For media, including audio and video, it's the time offset of the start of a clip within a larger file.\n\nNote that Event uses startDate/endDate instead of startTime/endTime, even when describing dates with times. This situation may be clarified in future revisions.

properties.name: schema:subOrganization
properties.text: sub organization: A relationship between two organizations where the first includes the second, e.g., as a subsidiary. See also: the more specific 'department' property.

properties.name: schema:alternateName
properties.text: alternate name: An alias for the item.

properties.name: schema:taxonRank
properties.text: taxon rank: The taxonomic rank of this taxon given preferably as a URI from a controlled vocabulary – typically the ranks from TDWG TaxonRank ontology or equivalent Wikidata URIs.

properties.name: schema:telephone
properties.text: telephone: The telephone number.

properties.name: schema:timeRequired
properties.text: time required: Approximate or typical time it usually takes to work with or through the content of this work for the typical or target audience.

properties.name: schema:uploadDate
properties.text: upload date: Date (including time if available) when this media object was uploaded to this site.

properties.name: schema:video
properties.text: video: An embedded video object.

properties.name: schema:weight
properties.text: weight: The weight of the product or person.

properties.name: schema:width
properties.text: width: The width of the item.

licenses.use: names and contract, already in the runtime bundle
